http/internal/hpack_primitives#

The HPACK primitives (RFC 7541 §5): prefixed integers and string literals, with Huffman decoding.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The HPACK primitives (RFC 7541 §5): prefixed integers and string literals, with Huffman decoding.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.
